name: Szene Wien
notes: Uses the WP Grid Builder admin-ajax endpoint (POST /?wpgb-ajax=refresh&_mehr_laden=<offset>, form field wpgb=<json grid settings>) to page through the homepage 'upcoming events' grid in batches of 12; each event card then gets its own detail page fetched for exact Beginn time, price/tickets, and description. Single fixed venue (Hauffgasse 26, 1110 Wien) for every event. price_min is 0 only when the card/page literally says 'Eintritt frei'; ticketed shows never show a price on-site (only an oeticket link) so price_min/price_text stay null. category is not published anywhere on the site, always null. Site publishes ~14 months out (91 events through Oct 2027 at build time); with the default 90-day horizon only 57 of those are emitted.
